observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a diesel engine valve cover stamped 'DAF 24 VALVE' and a manifold stamped 'DAF' with a part number (1428063).
Photo 1 and 2 show the same or similar engine sitting outdoors in a yard, surrounded by several other stripped engines and gearboxes under a tarp.
The engine in photos 1-2 appears to be the same DAF unit, partially disassembled with visible hoses, a fan, and exposed wiring loom hanging loose.
No ignition, compression test, dyno, or running video is shown; only static photos of a cold, stationary engine.
General surface dirt, oxidation on metal surfaces, and grease residue are visible, consistent with a used, outdoor-stored engine.
A watermark 'HEPH AUTOS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear on all three photos, indicating a reposted listing image.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful, in excellent condition, ready for work
claims.evidence: Photos show visible dirt, oxidation, and loose wiring; no clean/polished state confirmed.
No import documents, customs paperwork, or shipping labels visible in any photo.
No video or audio of the engine running is provided; engine appears static and cold in all three photos.
No odometer, ECU printout, or service record shown.
No seal, bolt-torque marks, or factory stamp closeups shown to confirm the engine has not been disassembled.
